title: Core Quintet #35
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 5:4 aspect ratio, five women in a single row.

A photograph of FIVE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 5 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long teased neon pink and lime hair, a bold cheeky grin, cool and composed, sleek straight hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain — a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease, dense overglaze florals filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme gold-and-red platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Iranian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, cool and composed, elegant updo hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting — a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense acanthus scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Iranian woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, sultry, low bun hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman: a real adult Korean woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair ivory skin, smoky eyes in champagne-gold glitter shadow, a sharp winged liner, full lashes, softly contoured cheekbones with a glowing highlight, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy gradient lips in deep rose, long sleek black waves, a confident, luminous expression, sultry, elegant updo hair, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic — a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold ankle-strap stilettos, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Iranian woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, bold and confident, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, matte finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Far-right woman's body art: painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay — a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands following every deep crease, dense lattice fills filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme bold silver platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 5, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 5:4 landscape 8K.
